reliability_rules: Every endurance workload is bounded by explicit cycles or duration.
Unsupported capabilities are NOT_APPLICABLE and are never invented.
Critical thermal state causes safe abort.
CameraService errors, crashes and ANRs are independently recorded.
Memory-leak validation compares baseline, peak and recovered memory without drop_caches.
